panels.title: Desired vs current replicas
panels.description: Live HPA actuation, per KEDA HPA (keda-hpa-<cluster>). In dry-run / transition (ScaledObject paused in both directions) the HPA's desiredReplicas is frozen to currentReplicas, so the two lines coincide — read the recommendation from the matching read-load panel (connections or CPU) instead: desired = 1 + ceil(load / target), clamped to [minReplicas..maxReplicas] (floor = max(minReplicas, maxSyncReplicas+1, 2)).

panels.title: Active read connections (replicas, per cluster)
panels.description: Replica-scoped active connections per cluster — the ReadConnections autoscaler input. For a cluster on metric: ReadConnections the recommendation is desired = 1 + ceil(this / target), clamped to [minReplicas..maxReplicas] (floor = max(minReplicas, maxSyncReplicas+1, 2)); CPU-mode clusters read the 'Replica CPU' panel instead. Restricted to standby pods via the same replica join as the ScaledObject query and scoped per cluster (label_cnpg_io_cluster), so it also surfaces the recommendation in dry-run, where panel 1's desired line is frozen to current.

panels.title: Replication lag (seconds, per cluster)
panels.description: Max standby replication lag per cluster. Deliberately joins ALL instance pods (no instance-role filter, unlike the read-load panels) because lag is a per-standby signal collapsed by max(); the primary reports no lag. Feeds the opt-in replication-lag brake (autoscaling.maxReplicationLagSeconds).

panels.title: Scaling limited (ScalingLimited=true)
panels.description: Per KEDA HPA: 1 while the HPA reports ScalingLimited=true — set at BOTH the ceiling (maxReplicas) and the floor (an idle cluster's desired clamps UP to minReplicas), so this is 1 on quiet clusters too. Distinguish via the 'Desired vs current replicas' panel; the DatabaseAutoscalerAtMax alert scopes to the ceiling case (desired >= maxReplicas), where raising maxReplicas adds read capacity.

panels.title: Replica CPU (millicores, per cluster)
panels.description: Replica-scoped postgres-container CPU per cluster (millicores) — the ReadCPUUtilization autoscaler input. For a cluster on metric: ReadCPUUtilization the recommendation is desired = 1 + ceil(this / target), clamped to [minReplicas..maxReplicas] (floor = max(minReplicas, maxSyncReplicas+1, 2)). Mirrors the ScaledObject's CPU query (rate over 5m x 1000) restricted to standby pods.
